name: specdrive
description: SpecDrive — spec-driven development, made visual and effortless for everyone
author: SpecDrive

scripts.build:mcp: esbuild mcp/server.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=out/mcp/server.mjs
scripts.dist: electron-vite build && npm run build:mcp && electron-builder --mac
scripts.release: electron-vite build && npm run build:mcp && electron-builder --mac --publish always
